summary: Require compatible machine fluid filters when acquiring labs and research ingredients.
details: The shared machine index records directional fluid filters once. Distinct recipe fluids need distinct compatible capacity; one unfiltered port cannot satisfy several fluids while incompatible filtered ports inflate the total.

The actual lab and science services retain independent alternatives, compatible machine research gates and self-lock rejection. Rocket construction uses the same input check; real recipe-source replacement invalidates warm filter decisions.

Controlled Lua tests reproduce the predecessor failure. Exact native slot assignment, fluidbox_index, temperatures, production, changed catalogues and saved-world behavior remain separate qualification requirements.
